missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend magnesium citrate when kidney function, current supplement intake or relevant medication use is unknown.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer magnesium deficiency from nonspecific symptoms or dietary estimate alone.
Do not duplicate magnesium from multiple products.
Kidney impairment and interacting medicines require professional review.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease or reduced renal function.
Persistent diarrhea, significant gastrointestinal symptoms or suspected toxicity.
Use of medicines with clinically relevant magnesium interactions.
population_and_context: Adults whose dietary magnesium intake may be low; citrate is one magnesium salt and gastrointestinal tolerability differs by formulation.
dose_constraints: No dose can be set by this rule. Total elemental magnesium and upper limits from supplements/medications must be checked separately from food magnesium.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS magnesium fact sheet provides reference intakes, upper limits and interactions; low dietary intake alone is not a diagnosis or automatic indication. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
